messages.content: Approval came through. Please replace the Friday return with the Saturday morning nonstop and add Friday night to the Hampton stay. Both holds expire this afternoon, so go ahead now.

I still have the Saturday, June 19 Delta nonstop from Providence to Atlanta departing at 9:05 a.m. and arriving at 11:36 a.m. The exchange adds $96.40 after applying the full remaining value of your original ticket. The same Hampton room can be extended through Saturday checkout for $361.47. Shall I complete both using the card ending in 1842?
Yes. Confirm that the $96.40 is the only airline charge and that the original return is being exchanged, not left as a separate credit.
Confirmed. Delta will apply the ticket value from the unused Friday return directly to the Saturday flight. There is no change fee and no separate residual credit; the new charge is exactly $96.40.
Good. Complete the exchange and the hotel extension.

The flight exchange is complete. Your confirmation remains H7Q4LM. The outbound on June 16 is unchanged, and the new return is Delta 1882 on Saturday, June 19, departing PVD at 9:05 a.m. and arriving ATL at 11:36 a.m. The card ending in 1842 was charged $96.40.
And is the hotel definitely the same room, with checkout Saturday rather than a second reservation?

Yes. Hampton confirmation PVD62841 has been amended in place for June 16-19, with Saturday checkout. The hotel confirmed continuous occupancy in the same room, so no room move or separate check-in is required. The added night is $361.47, bringing the updated stay total to $924.21, payable at the hotel.
Please give me the final confirmations together and note the cancellation deadline for the added night.

Updated confirmations: Delta H7Q4LM now returns Saturday, June 19 on nonstop flight 1882, PVD 9:05 a.m. to ATL 11:36 a.m.; the exchange charge was $96.40 after the original ticket value was applied. Hampton PVD62841 now covers June 16-19 in the same room, with an updated total of $924.21. The Friday-night extension may be canceled without penalty through 6:00 p.m. Eastern on June 17. Updated airline and hotel confirmations have been sent to your email.
